questions.question:
Read the passage below and answer the questions:

'The concept of global warming refers to the gradual increase in the average temperature of Earth's atmosphere, primarily due to the greenhouse effect caused by excessive emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.'

Q: What is the main cause of global warming according to the passage?
questions.solution: **Answer:** The main cause of global warming is the excessive emission of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases, which intensify the greenhouse effect and raise Earth's average temperature.
questions.knowledgeNote: Comprehension: Read carefully, identify key ideas, and answer using your own words when possible.

questions.question:
Read the notice below and answer the questions that follow.

NOTICE
ANNUAL SPORTS DAY - GRADE 11
All Grade 11 students must report to the east ground by 7:30 a.m. on 14 Magh. The 100-metre heats begin at 8:00 a.m. and the relay final is at 11:00 a.m. Each house team must submit its list of participants to the Physical Education teacher **before 7:15 a.m.** Students must bring their sports shoes and a water bottle. Absentees will not be allowed to compete.

(i) Sita reaches school at 7:20 a.m. Can she still submit her team's list of participants? Give a reason.
(ii) Ramesh arrives at 7:45 a.m. and asks to take part in the 100-metre race. What will happen to him, and why?
(iii) State two things a reader must look for first when scanning a notice like this one.
questions.solution:
**(i)** No. The list of participants had to be submitted **before 7:15 a.m.**, but Sita reached school only at 7:20 a.m. - five minutes after the deadline. A notice gives a fixed deadline, so arriving late makes the submission impossible.

**(ii)** Ramesh will not be allowed to compete. All students had to report to the east ground by 7:30 a.m. and the heats began at 8:00 a.m., so at 7:45 a.m. he has already missed both the reporting time and the start of his race. The notice also states clearly that absentees will not be permitted to compete.

**(iii)** Two things to look for first:
1. **Dates and times** - 14 Magh, 7:30 a.m., before 7:15 a.m., 8:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m.
2. **Deadlines and compulsory rules** - the words 'must', 'before' and 'will not be allowed', which show what the reader must do and what happens if it is not done.
questions.knowledgeNote: To scan a notice, look first for dates, times and deadlines; words like 'must', 'before' and 'will not' carry the binding rules.
